text: ポケモンが　１ぴき　しか　いないようだな　また　きなさいよ

structure.jp: ポケモンが　１ぴき　しか　いないようだな
structure.en: it seems you have only one Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜しか〜ない
patterns.explanation: しか together with a 'not' verb means 'only that and nothing more'. １ぴき　しか　いない = 'there is only one'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ says 'it seems that', judging from what the speaker sees. いないようだ = 'it seems there isn't'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい after a verb is a firm but kind order. きなさい = 'come'.
